summary: Name the writer, sequence and missing predecessor case when a claim backup cannot prove its writer chain

compatibility.detail: No backup format, endpoint, acceptance or chain-validity change. Existing errors now identify the writer and sequence, distinguish an absent retained predecessor from a retained wrong hash, and state missing checkpoint coverage without promising replication catch-up will fix historical gaps. For an absent predecessor only, the diagnostic states that it may yet arrive while this writer's history is arriving; settled replication still does not prove completeness. The wrong-hash case offers no catch-up advice.

schema.detail: No schema, registry or storage layout change.

rules.detail: No checkpoint, retention, signature or history rule change. Uncovered predecessors continue to refuse export and restore.

downtime.detail: No service action is required by this diagnostic change.

manual.detail: No new command or recovery procedure. An exact failure witness still needs investigation; this does not authorize repair, gap certification or a production backup attempt.

recovery.detail: No data mutation or recovery change. The live backup deadline and snapshot-lifetime issue remains separate.
